name: sada
description: صدى — مدير محتوى ذكي على Cloudflare

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run cycles && npm run contrast && npm run tokens && npm run classes && npm run rtl && npm run dead && npm run columns && npm run migrations && npm run tenancy && npm run html && npm run markup && npm run docs && npm run delivery && npm run smoke && npm run drill && npm run sus && npm run journeys:gate && npm run test
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada --env production --remote
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada-staging --env staging --local
scripts.render: tsx scripts/render_panel.ts /tmp/panel.html && tsx scripts/render_screens.ts && tsx scripts/render_kit.ts /tmp/screen-kit.html && tsx scripts/render_legal.ts /tmp/privacy.html /privacy
scripts.audit: npm run render && node scripts/audit_design.mjs --self-test /tmp/screen-404.html && node scripts/audit_design.mjs $(node scripts/screens.mjs base) && node scripts/audit_scale.mjs $(node scripts/screens.mjs base) && node scripts/audit_scale.mjs --size large $(node scripts/screens.mjs base) && npm run a11y && npm run aria && npm run primary && npm run disabled && npm run faces && npm run mobile && npm run mobile:large && npm run print && npm run forced && npm run csp && npm run links && npm run copy && npm run size
scripts.forced: node scripts/audit_forced.mjs --self-test /tmp/screen-404.html && node scripts/audit_forced.mjs $(node scripts/screens.mjs base)
